svg.title: Shinrai Ou — Throne of Thunder. Draft 4 / Storm classification / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 recalibration).
svg.desc: 8 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Mandate of Thunder forks into Vajra Tempering then Thunder King's Wrath, or Lightning Rod then Judgement from Above. Raiment of Storms forks into Galvanic Rebuke then Thunder Answers Thunder. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Storm jutsu.

Its only supported enemy debuff is Hammer's 35% Increase Damage Taken on area enemies, which anchors the Exposure route; its only defensive row is the Storm Cloak's 40% Reflect, which anchors the Bulwark route. Increase Damage Given has three rows (two on the Cloak, one on Raijin) which compound with each other when their windows overlap, with the bloodline's own Increase Damage Given passive multiplying last, so it is kept as Foundation and capstone-secondary glue at +5% at most rather than given a route of its own. BUFF","adverse":false,"base":1.0,"gain":0,"final":1.0,"calculation":"static","supported":false,"capped_at_100":false}],"advanced_arts":["Thunder Answers Thunder"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":"Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has four supported tags on nine rows (Damage x4, Increase Damage Given x3, Increase Damage Taken x1, Reflect x1). Mandate of Thunder forks into a Damage route and an Exposure route; Raiment of Storms carries a single Reflect chain. Increase Damage Given gets no route of its own: two of its three rows sit on the same 40 AP Storm Cloak cast and the bloodline's Increase Damage Given passive multiplies on top, so it stays glue at +5% at most. Mandate of Thunder is therefore a universal node (in all 8 legal full builds): Raiment's 3-BP chain needs a fourth purchase and Mandate is the only prerequisite-closed one. A Hidden Art leaf under Raiment would be filler; each single-tag version was checked against the legal builds: a Reflect leaf lifts Reflect past +10%; an Increase Damage Given leaf at +1% or +2% leaves 06, 07, 08 plus the leaf dominated by 01, 06, 07, 08, and at +3% or more lifts the stacking buff rows past the +5% glue level; an Increase Damage Taken leaf at +1% or +2% is dominated the same way, at +3% twins Lightning Rod's builds and at +4% or +5% dominates both Lightning Rod hybrids; a Damage leaf at +1 or +2 is dominated or twinned by Vajra Tempering's builds, at +3 twins the Burst build (01, 02, 03, 06) and dominates Vajra Tempering's hybrids, and at +4 or more exceeds +5 Damage. A split leaf would be a one- or two-point sliver of tags other nodes already own, with no role of its own. Burst and Exposure each keep two fourth-purchase choices; Bulwark has one. Three distinct complete builds exist.","design_notes":["Reference reuse: Mandate, Vajra Tempering and Thunder King's Wrath use Taiyo Kami's Dawnheart, Crown of Cinders and Solar Cataclysm flats (+2% Increase Damage Given / +2% Increase Damage Taken, +2 Damage, +3 Damage); Thunder Answers Thunder mirrors Sovereign Sun (+5% / +3% Increase Damage Given). Routes: Burst +5 Damage; Exposure +10% Increase Damage Taken (Mandate +2%, Lightning Rod +3%, Judgement from Above +5%); Bulwark +10% Reflect (Raiment +2%, Galvanic Rebuke +3%, Thunder Answers Thunder +5%). Raiment of Storms carries no Damage (its former +1 was removed under RUL-2026-10-03-005), so no allocation exceeds +5 Damage; Increase Damage Given peaks at +5%.","Main tree and passives: both Cloak Increase Damage Given rows match the kit's Storm hits (row 0 via its Highest stat filter, row 2 via Storm) and compound with Raijin's: three 35% rows multiply a hit all three match by \u00d71.35\u00b3 \u2248 \u00d72.46 (\u00d71.40\u00b3 \u2248 \u00d72.74 at the +5% maximum), and the bloodline passive (25 + 0.15/lvl) multiplies last. The buffs also reach normal jutsu and weapons (row 0 and Raijin: Highest-stat or element-less hits; row 2: Storm, Lightning, Water or element-less).","Uptime: cooldown 7 on all five jutsu (attacks 60 AP, Cloak 40 AP) outlasts every two-round window. Each buff and the exposure is live only in the two rounds after its cast, never on its own jutsu's hit, so Raijin's buff and Hammer's exposure feed the other attacks, normal jutsu and weapons, not their own next cast. Staggered Cloak and Raijin casts give about four of seven rounds of enhanced Increase Damage Given. Both buff sources land on the caster at cast time; Hammer's exposure sits on its tiles.","Fourth-purchase choices: Burst (01, 02, 03) finishes with Lightning Rod (exposure 40%) or Raiment of Storms (Reflect 42%); Exposure (01, 04, 05) finishes with Vajra Tempering (+2 Damage) or Raiment of Storms (Reflect 42%); Bulwark (06, 07, 08) finishes only with Mandate of Thunder (see the narrow-kit exception). Hybrids without a capstone (01, 02, 04, 06 and 01, 02, 06, 07) spread +2 to +5 across four tags and stay non-dominated.","Reflect and untouched rows: the Cloak Reflect row lists all four stat types and no element, so it matches effectively every hit the caster takes, pierce included; the return bypasses shields, and other Reflect sources add to it up to the 60%-of-hit cap (50% leaves ten points). Daibutsu's recoil 40%, Railgun's stun 100 and the two move rows are unsupported and unchanged; the bloodline passives (Increase Damage Given; 15% Decrease Damage Taken against Lightning) are not potency targets."],"risks":["Classification: Storm is the single qualifying element; sharing it with Arashima, Godstorm Eclipse and Stormboat Willy is expected (RUL-2026-10-03-005). 6 of 9 kit rows carry Storm; the 3 element-less rows (Storm Cloak rows 0 and 1, Raijin's buff) need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver (matching None instead would reach every element-less row on any jutsu). Off-kit Storm coverage (NORMAL/SPECIAL/EVENT/FORBIDDEN) is unverified.","Increase Damage Given stacking: with both Cloak rows and Raijin live, three 35% rows compound to \u00d71.35\u00b3 \u2248 \u00d72.46 on a hit all three match, before the bloodline passive multiplies; at the +5% maximum it is \u00d71.40\u00b3 \u2248 \u00d72.74. Each row stays far below the 100 cap, but the combined per-hit amplification is high and was not simulated against peer kits.","Exposure: Hammer's area Increase Damage Taken reaches 45% at the +10% route maximum, and allies' matching non-pierce hits on the exposed enemies gain too. Not simulated.","Reflect cap and uptime: other Reflect sources (main tree, items) add to the Cloak's 50% and could saturate the 60%-of-pre-shield-damage cap, wasting part of the +10%. Reflect pays only when the caster is hit in the two rounds after the Cloak's cast (tags.ts reflect: !isNew && !castThisRound), so Bulwark is a duelist's build with no Decrease Damage Taken row to pair. Not simulated.","Universal node: Mandate of Thunder is in all 8 legal full-budget builds because the Bulwark chain has no other prerequisite-closed fourth purchase, so the 4-BP budget carries 3 BP of real choice. Accepted under the narrow-kit exception, which records why every leaf under Raiment of Storms would be filler (dominated, a twin, or past a ceiling or the glue level).","Delivery: Daibutsu Thunder (radius-1 spawn on an OTHER_USER target), Raijin (ground circle spawn) and Hammer (spiral around the caster) are area deliveries; realized hits and exposure depend on positioning. Every harmful row is friendly fire ENEMIES, so no ally hazards. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Storm jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Thunder King's Wrath path + Raiment of Storms
Judgement from Above path + Vajra Tempering
Thunder Answers Thunder path + Mandate of Thunder
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · REF: Reflect
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE SHINRAI OU KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Storm Cloak · Increase Damage Given (each of 2 effects)
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
8 legal four-skill allocations · 3 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Draft 4 / Storm classification / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 recalibration)
